I'm the guy who texts you about a package you never ordered.
I send thousands of these a night. I only need a few of you to tap.
The link looks just like the delivery company. Same colors. Same little truck.
You type in your address. Fine. Then it asks for a one-dollar redelivery fee.
One dollar. Nobody thinks twice about one dollar.
But you just gave me your card number... and the code on the back.
Before your coffee's cold, I've bought a laptop with it.
In 2024 alone, people told the FTC they lost four hundred and seventy million dollars to texts like mine.
You know who I never get?
People who ignore the link... and type the real website in themselves. I hate those people.
